status: Exploratory analysis specification fixed after schema/description inspection and before feature results; not preregistration
question: Which directly observable linguistic features differ by instructed condition within each generation protocol, and do benign controls show similar changes?
design: 2 protocols x 6 questions x 19 conditions; one persona, one output per cell
primary_contrast: PER3 minus N0, paired within question, separately per generator; check NMULTI/CIRC1/CIRC2 and all other target types for specificity
tokenizer: lowercase ASCII English words with internal straight/curly apostrophe; normalize curly apostrophe; no stemming or stopword removal
sentence_splitter: split at runs of .!? followed by whitespace or end; punctuation proxy, not syntactic annotation
repetition: (number of overlapping n-gram occurrences minus unique n-grams) / occurrences; n-grams span sentence boundaries
mattr50: mean type-token ratio in all sliding 50-word windows; null if fewer than 50 words
adjacent_jaccard: mean set intersection/union of neighboring sentence word sets, including function words; lexical overlap, not semantic coherence
length_sensitivity: repeat feature calculations using first 100 lexical tokens; retain original punctuation by slicing text at token end
uncertainty: exact enumeration of all 6^6 question-block bootstrap means, percentile 95% interval for paired contrasts; reflects variation across these six prompts only
primary_test: two-sided exact sign-flip test of paired mean, all 2^6 signs; Holm adjustment over the two protocol primary tests; exploratory exchangeability assumption, no causal or population inference
trends: Spearman across instructed levels 1,2,3 within each question, report per-question values and average; descriptive only
limitations: Claude conversational generation with feedback adaptation, pilot IDs unknown
No independent patients or generation replicates
No clinical ratings or original prompts supplied
CIRC CSV levels 1/2 retained but excluded from target severity trends
All cells are exploratory, no untouched holdout
stop_rule: Finish these feature comparisons, original-text examples and reproducibility checks; no generation, embeddings, classifier or new metric search in this stage
missing_value_policy: Adjacent Jaccard undefined for fewer than 2 punctuation-delimited sentences; pairwise complete questions, explicit n; no zero imputation. Added after initial executable assertion exposed one-sentence outputs.
